rules.statement: The undertaking of the Secretary to the Treasury contained in clauses 9 and 10 of the Agreement binds the State.
rules.supporting_quote: The undertaking of the Secretary to the Treasury contained in clauses 9 and 10 of the Agreement marked P7, binds the State.
